title: A quick tour of mclustAddons
text: mclustAddons contributed R package extends functionality available mclust package (Scrucca et al. 2016, Scrucca et al. 2023). particular, following methods included: density estimation data bounded support (Scrucca, 2019); modal clustering using modal EM algorithm Gaussian mixtures (Scrucca, 2021); entropy estimation via Gaussian mixture modeling (Robin & Scrucca, 2023). document gives quick tour mclustAddons (version 0.10). written R Markdown, using knitr package production. References methodologies implemented provided end document.

title: Gaussian mixture-based estimation of entropy — EntropyGMM
text: EntropyGMM() returns estimate entropy based estimated Gaussian mixture model (GMM) fitted using mclust package. matrix data values provided, GMM preliminary fitted data entropy computed. EntropyGauss() returns entropy multivariate Gaussian distribution covariance matrix sigma. nats2bits() bits2nats() convert input values nats bits, viceversa. Information-theoretic quantities different units depending base logarithm used: nats expressed base-2 logarithms, whereas bits natural logarithms.

title: Range–power transformation — rangepowerTransform
text:
range-power transformation can applied variables bounded support. Lower bound case Suppose \(x\) univariate random variable lower bounded support \(\mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{X}} \equiv (l,\infty)\), \(l > -\infty\). Consider preliminary range transformation defined \(x \mapsto (x - l)\), maps \(\mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{X}} \mathbb{R}^{+}\). range-power transformation continuous monotonic transformation defined $$ t(x; \lambda) =  egin{cases} \dfrac{(x-l)^{\lambda} - 1}{\lambda} & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda 
e 0 \[1ex] \log(x-l) & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda = 0 \end{cases} $$ back-transformation function $$ t^{-1}(y; \lambda) =  egin{cases} (\lambda y + 1)^{1/\lambda} + l & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda 
e 0 \[1ex] \exp(y)+l & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda = 0 \end{cases} $$ Lower upper bound case Suppose \(x\) univariate random variable bounded support \(\mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{X}} \equiv (l,u)\), \(-\infty < l < u < +\infty\). Consider preliminary range transformation defined \(x \mapsto (x - l)/(u - x)\), maps \(\mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{X}} \mathbb{R}^{+}\). case, range-power transformation continuous monotonic transformation defined $$ t(x; \lambda) =  egin{cases} \dfrac{ \left( \dfrac{x-l}{u-x} ight)^{\lambda} - 1}{\lambda} & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda 
e 0 \[2ex] \log \left( \dfrac{x-l}{u-x} ight) & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda = 0, \end{cases} $$ back-transformation function $$ t^{-1}(y; \lambda) =  egin{cases} \dfrac{l + u (\lambda y + 1)^{1/\lambda}}{1+(\lambda y + 1)^{1/\lambda}} & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda 
e 0 \[1ex] \dfrac{l + u \exp(y)}{1+\exp(y)} & \quad	ext{}\; \lambda = 0 \end{cases} $$
